title: Participant data — Participant
description: Registration and consent metadata, and demographics data.

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Source type string, primary_key_type global (links every dataset). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D025).

REGISTRATION_YEAR.title: Year of Registration derived from Date of Registration
REGISTRATION_YEAR.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

REGISTRATION_MONTH.title: Month of Registration derived from Date of Registration
REGISTRATION_MONTH.$comment: The source states no range; 1-12 is the calendar range, not a plausibility bound (D024).

CONSENT_VERSION.title: Consent Version
CONSENT_VERSION.$comment: The source lists no codes or format for this string.

CONSENT_YEAR.title: Year of Consent derived from Date of Consent
CONSENT_YEAR.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

CONSENT_MONTH.title: Month of Consent derived from Date of Consent
CONSENT_MONTH.$comment: The source states no range; 1-12 is the calendar range, not a plausibility bound (D024).

BIRTH_YEAR.title: Year of Birth derived from Date of Birth
BIRTH_YEAR.$comment: Sparse coding: only the suppressed code is listed; every other value is the year itself. The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

BIRTH_MONTH.title: Month of Birth derived from Date of Birth
BIRTH_MONTH.$comment: Sparse coding: only the suppressed code is listed; every other value is the month itself.
